label: STATIC COST ESTIMATE
unit: relative Cortex-M0 cost units (not cycles or time)
notes: Weights are deliberately simple relative weights for ARMv6-M triage.
Software floating-point helpers are expanded using their linked helper bodies when a static caller score is calculated.
Instruction-dependent latency, flash wait states, taken paths, pipeline refill, alignment, bus contention, and peripheral waits are not modeled.
No score in this framework is a physical cycle or time measurement.
